records.text: A neighborhood witness reportedly saw a bald man with two people in the back of a Dodge Challenger.
records.speaker: Neighborhood witness quoted about Challenger occupants (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Every time this car is seen on or around campus, whether it's later that day, they're like it's Tyler Robinson's. Even when a neighbor said, actually, I saw a bald guy with two people in the back, they're like, still Tyler Robinson still counts as Tyler Robinson for us.
